name: Member's Mark Southern Style Chicken Bites (Breaded Breast Chunks Warning)
whyItWorks: Famous as a Chick-fil-A copycat nugget, these breaded chicken breast chunks are brined in dill pickle juice and par-fried in oil. The salty pickle brine and deep-fried breading can spark intense heartburn and cramps.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Fried & Acid Warning: Oven-bake thoroughly. If sensitive, peel away outer fried breading to eat the inner tender chicken.
